mods.name: NoExpensive
mods.description: The anvil has no expensive restrictions!

releases.notes:
## 🆕Features

- Show the name and the description of every setting in the language of the game, in Chinese and English
- Draw the compatibility with the name the game gives an enchantment, which has no icon of its own, and
  find one by that name or by its id
- Complete an enchantment id per segment, so `mending` completes to `minecraft:mending` just like vanilla,
  in the screen and in the commands, where a value written without a namespace is the one of the default
  one

## 🐛Bug fixes

- Reset the compatibility restores the combinations it was built with instead of clearing it
